item.title: DiZoglio takes her battle to audit the Legislature to the state's high court
item.description: Massachusetts Auditor Diana DiZoglio filed a lawsuit Tuesday with the state’s Supreme Judicial Court to force the Legislature to hand over financial documents as part of an audit into lawmakers' businesses.

item.title: New images show masked suspect outside Nancy Guthrie's home the day she disappeared
item.description: Officials believe Nancy Guthrie was taken from her Tucson, Arizona, home over a week ago.

item.title: ICE chief defends his officers' actions before Congress after the deaths of 2 protesters
item.description: Todd Lyons, the head of Immigration and Customs Enforcement, defended his agency’s officers before Congress on Tuesday, standing behind their tactics and saying they would not be intimidated as they carry out the president’s mass deportation agenda.

item.title: Boston's World Cup fan festival is coming to City Hall Plaza
item.description: State and city officials made the long-awaited announcement Tuesday on where World Cup fans without tickets can gather in Boston to watch the matches: City Hall Plaza.

item.title: The Masked Bandit
item.description: Recorded live at Symphony Hall with Boston Symphony Orchestra players and a star-studded cast, this Sioux legend follows a rascally raccoon on a gutsy -- and gummy -- quest.

item.title: Mass. education secretary Tutwiler to step down; Salem superintendent Zrike will take on role
item.description: Tutwiler's departure adds to the turnover in the governor's team as she splits attention between reelection plans and governing during a busy year for both policy and politics.

item.title: Brainwaves: How does the brain love and hate?
item.description: Consciousness is how we are able to feel, dream and imagine. And yet -- scientists haven't figured out how consciousness definitively works. What we know, what we don’t and what that tells us about our brains.

item.title: U.S. pair, including Mass. native Dropkin, gets silver in mixed doubles curling
item.description: Dropkin and Thiesse became the first U.S. team to medal in Olympic mixed doubles, and Thiesse is the first American woman to medal in Olympic curling.

item.title: U.S. skater Maxim Naumov makes an emotional Olympic debut one year after losing parents in plane crash
item.description: Naumov carried the memory of his late parents with him to the Olympics on Tuesday night. Former pairs world champions Evgenia Shishkova and Vadim Naumov were among the 67 people killed when American Airlines Flight 5342 crashed into a military helicopter in January 2025.

item.title: Vermont State Police arrest protesters at ICE surveillance facility in Williston
item.description: All 13, whose ages range from 21 to 85, are scheduled to be arraigned on criminal trespassing charges in Chittenden County criminal court on March 2, state police said in a press release.
